Work with the deployed instance's script variables, which scripts read as `ctx.env`

Usage: hpy happyview env [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  push  Send keys from the project's .env to the instance's script variables, asking before each
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json      Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --no-input  Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions still need --yes.
                  Implied without a terminal
  -C <DIR>        Run as if started in DIR
  -h, --help      Print help
